answer: Admission auction gates entry: each epoch opens 100 seats, and each bidder locks a 60-coin deposit to pass the ridge. A ferrous gate, an on-chain bond check, verifies the deposit first, and a gale of audits sweeps winners, burning any clone's deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 auctions at 60 coins each, 60,000 coins sunk against a 30,000 monthly pool, so attacks lose money. An honest agent pays once and earns its full share undiluted.
